dataset.corporate_action_policy: canonical NSE: each session converted from the vendor basis to NSE raw prices by a per-session factor, then back-adjusted with the factors of the daily version
dataset.fingerprint_algo: snapshot-v1: sha256(canonical_json(manifest body)); objects sha256 of bytes
dataset.known_limitations: legacy row-level provenance unavailable (sample-verified); dividends not adjusted; renames not joined; universe is today's F&O list (survivorship); minute bars exclude pre-open auction volume; NSE daily extremes may lie outside the minute range (2023-06 to 2024-03)
dataset.price_basis: canonical NSE: each session converted from the vendor basis to NSE raw prices by a per-session factor, then back-adjusted with the factors of the daily version
dataset.source: AngelOne 1m (legacy Historify store, frozen, plus targeted AngelOne recovery)
